TRACE-ECG: covariate balance explorer

38 emulated trials, YNHHS; held-out characteristics not in any PS. Updated 2026-10-08.
Data: per-trial |SMD| from the paper 2 grid (audits/claude-v21-paper2/core; 5 PS bases × 6 arms × 6 PS methods). Its PS-Demo, PS-CVD5, hdPS and PS-Clinical × PS alone / + ECG / + permuted ECG cells are identical to paper 1's source. Unmatched |SMD| come from the v1.8 embedding comparison (same cohorts). Paper 1 primary: PS-Demo, 1:1 caliper 0.2, 58 items, 32 trials (the default view). Paper 2 primary: PS-CVD5, 54 non-coded items. Leakage-corrected masking (v1 audit, DEFECT_IMPACT §1) also removes held-out items that duplicate or are derived from a PS input: for PS-Clinical, echo EF, LV systolic grade and eGFR (plus the 4 coded-record items); for hdPS and for every CLMBR-T arm (real or permuted), the 4 coded-record items; for PS-CVD5 and PS-Flags, held-out codes and the prognostic score. Cells with fewer than 11 matched pairs are treated as failed (missing). Aggregates only.
Definitions. |SMD| = absolute standardized mean difference between initiators of the two drugs after matching or weighting. % balanced = share of a trial's items with |SMD| below the threshold, averaged over trials. Paired comparisons (vs PS alone) use, within each trial, only items observed in both arms, as in both papers. Relative reduction = 1 − (mean over trials of the arm's mean |SMD|) / (same for PS alone); 95% CI from 4,000 trial-level bootstrap resamples with numpy's generator and seed 20261001, reproduced here exactly. P = exact one-sided sign-flip test over trials (H1: the arm improves balance), on % balanced (paper 1's prespecified endpoint) and on mean |SMD| (paper 2's primary). The quality tiers and physiologic labels were assigned after the primary analyses (the labels by an LLM, blind to the results, with no clinician review). The expanded panel (~330 items) exists only for the primary method and four of the five bases, and is not leakage-masked.
